name: GIDE-Bench
description: GIDE-Bench is a general instruction-following and reasoning benchmark suite designed to evaluate models across a variety of NLP tasks (e.g., question answering, summarization, and commonsense reasoning) using standardized prompts. It measures how well models follow instructions and produce correct, coherent outputs across diverse task formats. The suite is intended for rapid comparative evaluation of instruction-tuned models.
reputation: Relatively new and low-profile; limited adoption beyond its author and immediate users.
